name: project-truss
description: Profile-aware, GitHub-native coordination for application development, scientific computing, and research.

interface.shortDescription: GitHub coordination for application and scientific outcomes.
interface.longDescription: Project Truss is a profile-aware harness around Matt Pocock techniques. It carries application behavior or falsifiable scientific claims through native GitHub coordination, reproducible evidence, truthful closeout, and safe local cleanup.
defaultPrompt: Use $project-truss:start to begin or resume profile-aware work; establish shared vocabulary and the application behavior or falsifiable scientific claim, invoke relevant Matt techniques, and continue through truthful closeout. Use $project-truss:setup once per repository.
